intent.verbatim: lock Option A and start building
intent.decoded: Build `socom introspect` per the ratified Option A: deterministic assertion extraction from the handoff, recorded as replayable assertions AND fed into the existing lesson-candidate pipeline. No model dependency. One atomic increment; defer the LLM-backed halves.

contract.goal: `socom introspect [handoff]` turns a closing handoff's machine-verifiable evidence commands into a replayable assertion log, idempotently, and births provisional lesson candidates from captured failures — never blocking closeout, never invoking a model.

check.run: socom introspect # in a repo with no handoffs
check.expect: exit 1, loud degrade (sibling convention: cycle/lesson on missing input)
appends one well-formed JSON row per <command> to .socom/assertions/log.jsonl; exit 0; prints a summary
0 new rows (idempotent on the assertion id = source-handoff + index)

check.run: introspect a handoff with an unexpected failure (exit!=0, no note) and an expected-fail (exit!=0, note=...)
check.expect: the un-noted failure births a provisional lesson candidate (source="introspect"); the noted expected-fail does NOT
exit 0, "no assertions to capture" — capture never blocks closeout
smoke all green (new introspect assertions incl. heal+block+idempotent dirs); assertion.xml well-formed (medium gate)

contract.out-of-scope: The four LLM-backed extractors (beliefs, reflections, plan, skills) — they need a model and would couple the substrate to one. Deferred to a later increment behind an explicit opt-in flag if ever wanted.
contract.regression-surface: Must not perturb existing lesson births (cycle hotspots) — introspect is a SECOND, independent birth path (source="introspect" vs "cycle"). doctor must stay clean (no canon hash change unless docstring is a view).
